pilot.title: Essential Social Formulas: Hello, Thanks, Sorry, Goodbye
pilot.purpose: Provide a prerequisite-free reviewed A1 content slice that a brand-new learner can genuinely start without fabricated prerequisite readiness or live AI-generated scored truth.

lessonBlueprint.name: Essential Social Formulas: Hello, Thanks, Sorry, Goodbye
lessonBlueprint.notes: Both active nodes are root nodes with no hard prerequisites. All scored content is fixed reviewed core. Free-spoken rehearsal targets the communicative-function node only and remains practice-only until a validated speech evaluator exists.

learningObjectives: Choose an appropriate greeting, first-meeting response, thanks, apology, and closing in short familiar situations.
Produce the reviewed social formulas in tightly controlled written prompts.
Rehearse the social formulas aloud without treating unvalidated speech as trusted evidence.
notInScope: Present be or other grammar analysis

teachBlocks.title: Greet someone
teachBlocks.explanation: Use Hello or Hi to open a simple social interaction.
teachBlocks.supportZh: 开始简单社交对话时，可以说 Hello 或 Hi。

teachBlocks.title: Respond on a first meeting
teachBlocks.english: Nice to meet you. — Nice to meet you, too.
teachBlocks.explanation: Use this exchange when meeting someone for the first time.
teachBlocks.supportZh: 第一次见面可以说 Nice to meet you，对方可以回答 Nice to meet you, too.

teachBlocks.title: Thank someone
teachBlocks.explanation: Use Thank you after someone helps you. You're welcome is a common response.
teachBlocks.supportZh: 别人帮助你后可以说 Thank you。对方常回答 You're welcome。

teachBlocks.title: Make a simple apology
teachBlocks.explanation: Use Sorry for a small everyday mistake or inconvenience.
teachBlocks.supportZh: 日常小错误或给别人带来一点不便时，可以说 Sorry。

teachBlocks.title: Close the interaction
teachBlocks.explanation: Use Goodbye or Bye when you leave or end a simple conversation.
teachBlocks.supportZh: 离开或结束简单对话时，可以说 Goodbye 或 Bye。

speakingPractice.prompt: Say one appropriate phrase for each cue: 1) you meet someone; 2) someone helps you; 3) you make a small mistake; 4) you leave.
speakingPractice.reasonUnscored: Phase 1 pilot has no validated speech evaluator yet; spoken practice must not create trusted mastery evidence.
